name: 书剑贰
group_note: Same Century/adm-single lineage as sjecl (adm/single/master.lpc + adm/daemons/securityd.lpc) -- most bugs identical, applied the same fixes: (1) §7.60 master.lpc log_error()/standard_trace() -> CHANNEL_D mid-compile crash, guarded both with find_object(CHANNEL_D). (2) §7.59 securityd.lpc valid_read() unconditional this_player() override denying load_object/include reads, excluded those two funcs. (3) §8.1 unhalved GBK byte-range is_chinese() + matching check_legal_name() length bound (4/8+i%2 window -> 2/4 per-codepoint). (4) §7.50 is_killing(who) object/string mismatch in the same 5 NPC dialogue files as sjecl (minus d/shaolin's, not present in this snapshot). New (not in sjecl): adm/daemons/backupd.lpc used an undefined BACKUP_DIR constant (preloaded, broke boot) -- added #define BACKUP_DIR "/backup/" to globals.h (a /backup directory already exists on disk, confirming the intended value). Also: adm/daemons/sited.lpc's is_valid() has a stricter/inverted rule than sjecl's -- ANY non-wizard id connecting from 127.0.0.1/localhost is unconditionally denied (only wiz_level(id) accounts may use loopback at all), so WASM testing (always 127.0.0.1) can only ever register wizard-status ids; worked around by seeding wizlist BEFORE testing and registering directly as fluffos (verifies admin and registration in one pass) rather than treating this as something to fix (a real security policy choice for this lineage, not a bug). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (no second sited-table entry needed here, unlike sjecl, since the 127.0.0.1 rule already grants wizards blanket loopback access). Verified: full registration -> enter world, permission displays (admin) correctly. One non-blocking content bug logged, not fixed: adm/daemons/questd.lpc's spread_quest()/init_dynamic_quest() calls environment() on a 0 object during preload's dynamic-quest-placement pass (caught, doesn't block boot). LPC formatter run across all 8527 files; reverted 1 file with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (d/quanzhen/hudi5.lpc) found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 85 formatter-touched files; directly diff-reviewed both map.lpc ASCII-art files present (d/shaolin x2) -- clean, cosmetic only. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
